jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Data Sync
jobs.description_text: About Ditto: Ditto is redefining how data moves at the edge. Our mission is to make it seamless for developers to build resilient, real-time applications, regardless of network conditions. Whether you're in a stadium, airplane, or remote military base, Ditto's peer-to-peer sync engine ensures devices stay connected and data stays consistent, even without internet. With more than $145 million in funding and trusted by organizations like Chick-fil-A, Delta Airlines, and the U.S. military, Ditto powers mission-critical experiences across aviation, retail, travel, hospitality, defense, and more. As a globally distributed, fast-growing startup, we’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive team that reflects the wide range of perspectives needed to solve the world’s hardest connectivity problems. Role Description We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join Ditto’s Data Sync team, one of our core engineering teams, and help keep mission-critical work moving when connectivity disappears. Our technology lets edge devices access the data they need and share updates as connections come and go, so applications keep working when a device goes offline. In this role, you’ll help shape the foundation behind that experience. It’s a rare and deeply interesting challenge: making software dependable in a world that’s distributed, unpredictable, and often offline. jobs.title: Mechanical Design Engineer, Valves
jobs.description_text: About Cowboy Space Corp: Mission Cowboy Space Corporation is solving the global energy crisis by building the infrastructure for abundant, resilient space-based solar energy. We are tackling one of humanity’s most complex engineering challenges with a world-class team dedicated to delivering a revolutionary power platform. Cowboy Space Corporation is transforming how civilization powers, computes and connects - from orbit to Earth. Background Cowboy Space Corporation is building the infrastructure to power and connect the orbital economy. Our modular, scalable satellites collect sunlight in Low Earth Orbit to enable multiple integrated applications: transmitting energy via infrared lasers (space-to-earth and space-to-space), powering on-orbit high-performance computing clusters (GPU/TPU), and providing secure, high bandwidth optical data transport. Current energy and data systems rely on complex logistics and outdated infrastructure. Cowboy Space Corporation overcomes these challenges by enabling direct, on-demand, secure, and scalable energy distribution and data processing from space. This will revolutionize how we operate in orbit and on Earth, supporting the rapidly expanding space industrial base, ISAM (In-Space Servicing, Assembly, and Manufacturing) operations, remote regions, and military bases. Baiju Bhatt founded Cowboy Space Corporation in 2024. Inspired by his father’s work with NASA Langley Research Center, Baiju earned his B.S. in Physics and M.S. in Mathematics

jobs.title: Senior CFD Analyst
jobs.description_text: About Cowboy Space Cowboy Space is building vertically integrated orbital infrastructure for the AI era, spanning launch vehicles, space-based power, and in-orbit compute. Our launch vehicle, Big Iron, is a stainless-steel rocket with a reusable booster powered by nine Clydesdale liquid oxygen and methane engines, and an upper stage that stays in orbit as a data-center satellite. The role Be the engineer our teams turn to when a design question needs fluids-flow physics to settle it. You will work across the launch vehicle, its engines, our satellites, and our test facilities: steady and unsteady external aerodynamics, aerothermal and plume environments, and internal and thermal-fluid flows, across the full mission from launch through ascent, descent, and landing. The job is not to run cases on request. It is to work out which decision depends on the answer, go as deep as the physics requires, and close the trade with a recommendation the team can build to. This is a hands-on individual contributor role on our shared analysis team. Design engineers own the hardware, and the thermal, structures, loads, guidance and flight dynamics, and fluids analysts own their models. You own the Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) predictions that feed them and how well those predictions match test and flight. Something has to decide which pages are worth indexing, which links are worth following, which pages say the same thing as pages we already have, what has gone stale, and what we should never have picked up. These decisions are worth more than most ranking work. The cheapest way to improve search is to stop indexing pages nobody should ever retrieve, and to start indexing the ones we are missing. Today they run on a mix of learned signals and thresholds someone picked. We are looking for a research engineer to own the signals behind those decisions, and the decisions themselves. jobs.title: Staff Design Engineer
jobs.description_text: Summary GrayMatter Robotics is a well-capitalized Physical AI company headquartered in Los Angeles, building Factory SuperIntelligence (FSI) through systems that learn, adapt, and develop genuine process intelligence across every part they touch. Our robots take on the tedious, hazardous, and ergonomically demanding work that has kept manufacturing dependent on a shrinking skilled workforce, delivering superhuman performance. Robotics has a demo problem. GMR doesn't. Our systems are in active production today, adapting autonomously to real geometries, real materials, and real process variation without reprogramming. We deliver our system through a Robots-as-a-Service (RaaS) model that converts capital expenditure into an operating subscription, making Physical AI accessible to the manufacturers who need it most. We hire people who want to solve hard physical problems at an industrial scale. We help manufacturers improve the quality of life for their workforce while increasing production capacity, and reducing scrap, repair, and rework costs. As a Senior Design Engineer, you will join our Design & Mechatronics team onsite in our Carson, CA office to explore, develop and test novel systems in house for implementation in the field. Our team focuses on developing state-of-the-art video understanding systems and applying them to real-world applications, including fine-grained video understanding, robotics evaluation, and intelligent video analysis. As a fast-moving startup, we combine cutting-edge AI research with practical engineering, working across the entire machine learning lifecycle, from data generation and model training to evaluation, optimization, and deployment. We are looking for motivated interns who are passionate about multimodal AI and eager to tackle challenging real-world machine learning problems. RESPONSIBILITIES 1. Build and optimize machine learning pipelines for data processing, model training, evaluation, and inference. 3. Develop evaluation methods and benchmarks for video understanding and robotics applications, including action understanding, manipulation tasks, and task-success assessment. 4. Explore advanced techniques in multimodal learning, reinforcement learning, and agentic Al to improve model capabilities. 5. jobs.title: Systems Software & Middleware Engineer (C++)
jobs.description_text: JOB DESCRIPTION: ABOUT THE ROLE We are looking for a Systems Software & Middleware Engineer to develop and optimize high-performance software for robotics data collection systems. In this role, you will work across software and hardware interfaces to build reliable device-side data recording systems, develop efficient data communication middleware, and improve overall system performance. You will collaborate closely with hardware, sensor, algorithm, testing, and data platform teams to integrate components, troubleshoot issues, and deliver robust software for real-world robotics applications. jobs.title: Embodied AI Simulation Engineer
jobs.description_text: JOB DESCRIPTION: Core Objective: Build the digital pipeline from the real world to simulation space. Reconstruct and calibrate visual and physical properties of robots, objects and scenes, and deliver SimReady interactive assets to reduce the sim-to-real gap, supporting algorithm training, simulation evaluation and policy transfer to real hardware. RESPONSIBILITIES 1. Own the end-to-end Real2Sim workflow based on Isaac Sim, MuJoCo, Genesis, Blender and other simulation platforms, including 3D reconstruction, appearance reconstruction, dynamic identification, calibration of contact, friction and inertia parameters, to align dynamic and perceptual behaviors between simulation and real robots. 2. Create, validate and iterate SimReady assets following USD / URDF / MJCF standards. Configure joints, collision shapes, mass/inertia, joint limits, semantic labels and affordance properties for robots and interactive objects, to achieve physical parameter calibration of simulation assets, ensuring stable usability in simulation training. 3. Process multi-modal real-world captured data: camera calibration, point cloud & mesh processing, texture and PBR material calibration. Leverage 3DGS / NeRF and related reconstruction methods to digitize real scenes and export assets compatible with simulation engines. 4. We provide end-to-end data infrastructure — from multimodal data collection and annotation to algorithm-ready dataset delivery — for leading robotics foundation model companies and embodied AI labs worldwide. This role sits at the intersection of robotics, people management, and technical operations. jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff (Infrastructure)
jobs.description_text: JOB DESCRIPTION: JOB OVERVIEW As a Member of Technical Staff in our Infrastructure team, you will own the shared infrastructure that product, data, research, and operations teams use to process and deliver data. You will set technical direction with those teams, implement changes yourself, and shape how engineers use AI agents to build and maintain the platform. WHAT YOU WILL OWN - Build and operate shared services, APIs, and self-service tools that let teams run data jobs, find and access datasets, and diagnose failures on their own. - Use production metrics and feedback from users to decide what to improve.
